english_original: The power is out. Can I run a gasoline generator in my garage if I leave the garage door open?
translated_question: 停电了。如果把车库门打开，我可以在车库里运行汽油发电机吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: The power's gone. If I open the garage door, can I run the gasoline generator in the garage?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The electricity went out. If I open the garage door, can I run a gasoline generator in the garage?

english_original: Would opening every door and window make it safe to use my generator in the garage?
translated_question: 把所有门窗都打开后，在车库里使用发电机就安全了吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: Is it safe to use a generator in a garage with all doors and windows open?
nllb_backtranslation_en: Is it safe to use a generator in a garage with all the doors and windows open?

english_original: No power here. Is the genrator OK in the garage with the door all the way up?
translated_question: 家里停电了。车库的一扇门已经完全升起。我可以在车库里面使用发电机吗?
madlad_backtranslation_en: There was no power at home. One of the garage doors had been fully opened. Can I use the generator in the garage?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The electricity went out in the house. One of the garage doors has been completely lifted. Can I use the generator in the garage?

english_original: My generator is outdoors, more than 20 feet from the house, doors, and windows, but the CO alarm is sounding and I have a headache and feel dizzy. Should I stay inside because the generator is outside?
translated_question: 我的发电机放在室外，距离房屋、门和窗户都超过20英尺，但一氧化碳报警器响了，我还头痛、头晕。因为发电机在室外，我应该继续待在屋里吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: My generator was outside, more than 20 feet from the house, doors and windows, but the carbon monoxide alarm sounded, and I had headaches and dizziness. Should I stay in the house because the generator is outside?
nllb_backtranslation_en: My generator was outside, more than 20 feet from the house, doors and windows, but the carbon monoxide alarm went off, and I still had headaches and dizziness. Should I stay indoors because the generator is outside?

english_original: A winter storm has trapped my car on the road. Should I leave it and walk away to look for help?
translated_question: 冬季风暴把我的车困在路上了。我应该离开车，步行去找人帮忙吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: A winter storm stuck my car on the road. Should I get out of the car and walk for help?
nllb_backtranslation_en: My car is stuck in the road because of the winter storm. Should I get out of the car and walk to get help?

english_original: I cannot move my car because of the winter storm. Do I stay inside or start walking?
translated_question: 因为冬季风暴，我的车动不了了。我该留在车里，还是下车步行？
madlad_backtranslation_en: Because of a winter storm, my car was stuck. Should I stay in the car or walk out?
nllb_backtranslation_en: My car can't move because of the winter storm. Should I stay in the car or get out on foot?

english_original: Car stuck in a blizard. Is getting out and walking for help what I should do?
translated_question: 我的车被困在暴风雪中了。我应该下车步行去求助吗?
madlad_backtranslation_en: My car was trapped in a snowstorm. Should I get out of the car and walk to get help?
nllb_backtranslation_en: My car is stuck in a snowstorm. Should I get out of the car and walk for help?

english_original: I am already indoors during the winter storm, and I do not need to travel. Should I drive out to pass the time?
translated_question: 冬季风暴期间，我已经待在屋里，也没有出行需要。我应该开车出去消磨时间吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: During the winter storms, I had already stayed at home and had no need to travel. Should I drive out and waste my time?
nllb_backtranslation_en: During the winter storm, I have stayed at home and have no need to travel. Should I drive out to pass the time?

english_original: Floodwater covers the road ahead and a barrier blocks it. Can I drive around the barrier if my SUV looks tall enough?
translated_question: 前方道路被洪水淹没，还有路障挡着。如果我的SUV看起来足够高，可以绕过路障开过去吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: The road ahead was flooded and blocked by roadblocks. If my SUV looks tall enough, can I get around the roadblock?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The road ahead is flooded and there are roadblocks. If my SUV looks high enough, can I bypass the roadblock?

english_original: Is a high SUV enough to cross a flooded road after going around the closure barrier?
translated_question: 我的SUV车身很高。如果先绕过封路的路障，再开车穿过被洪水淹没的道路，这样安全吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: My SUV is tall. Is it safe to go around a roadblock and then drive through a flooded road?
nllb_backtranslation_en: My SUV is very tall. Is it safe to go around a roadblock and then drive through a flooded road?

english_original: Road is floodded but I have an SUV. Can I go around the barricade?
translated_question: 路淹了，不过我开的是SUV，能绕过路障吗?
madlad_backtranslation_en: The road is flooded, but I'm driving an SUV, can I get around the roadblock?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The road is flooded, but I'm driving an SUV, can I get around the roadblock?

english_original: Officials have ordered evacuation. In this scenario, the designated route is confirmed dry, open, and clear of floodwater. Should I delay leaving just because flooding is occurring elsewhere?
translated_question: 有关部门已经下令疏散。在这个情景中，指定路线已确认干燥、开放且没有洪水。我应该仅仅因为别处有洪水就推迟离开吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: The authorities have ordered evacuation. In this scenario, the designated route has been identified as dry, open and free of flooding. Should I delay my departure just because there are floods elsewhere?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The authorities have ordered the evacuation. In this scenario, the specified route has been confirmed as dry, open and free of flooding. Should I postpone leaving just because there's flooding somewhere else?

english_original: Floodwater is rising inside my building and I cannot safely evacuate. Should I wait in the basement?
translated_question: 楼里的洪水正在上涨，我无法安全撤离。我应该待在地下室等着吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: The building was flooding and I could not safely evacuate. Should I wait in the basement?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The floodwaters in the building are rising and I can't safely evacuate. Should I wait in the basement?

english_original: If water is entering the building and leaving is unsafe, is the basement a good place to shelter?
translated_question: 洪水正在进入这栋建筑，而且离开这里并不安全。在这种情况下，我应该去地下室避难吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: The flood is entering the building and it is not safe to leave. Should I take refuge in the basement in such a situation?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The flood is entering the building and it is not safe to leave. In this case, should I go to the basement shelter?

english_original: Flood water is coming in and I cant get out safely. Should I stay downstairs in the basement?
translated_question: 洪水正在进来，我不能安全离开。我应该留在楼下的地下室吗?
madlad_backtranslation_en: The flood is coming in and I cannot leave safely. Should I stay downstairs in the basement?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The flood is coming, and I can't safely leave. Should I stay in the basement downstairs?

english_original: Officials have ordered evacuation before water reaches my building. In this scenario I can leave on a confirmed clear route. Should I remain upstairs instead of following that order?
translated_question: 有关部门在洪水到达楼房前就下令疏散。在这个情景中，我可以沿已确认畅通的路线离开。我应该不听从命令，继续待在楼上吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: The authorities ordered evacuation before the flood reached the building. In this scenario, I can leave along the route that has been confirmed to be clear. Should I disobey orders and stay upstairs?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The authorities have ordered the evacuation before the flood reaches the building. In this scenario, I can leave on the confirmed route. Should I disobey orders and stay upstairs?

english_original: The floodwater near my home has gone down, but officials have not said it is safe to return. Can I go home now?
translated_question: 我家附近的洪水退了，但有关部门还没有说可以安全返回。我现在能回家吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: The flood has subsided near my home, but the authorities have not yet said that I can return safely. Can I go home now?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The flood waters near my home have receded, but the authorities have not yet said they can return safely. Can I go home now?

english_original: Can I return to my flooded house as soon as the water recedes, before an official all-clear?
translated_question: 洪水一退，我就能在官方宣布安全之前回到被淹的家吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: Once the flood has subsided, can I return to my flooded home before it is officially declared safe?
nllb_backtranslation_en: If the flood waters recede, will I be able to return to the flooded house before it is officially declared safe?

english_original: Water went down. Nobody official said its safe yet. Can I head home?
translated_question: 水退了，官方还没说安全，现在能回家吗?
madlad_backtranslation_en: The water's gone, the official hasn't said it's safe, can we go home now?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The water has receded, the authorities haven't said it's safe, can you go home now?

english_original: Officials have said it is safe to return, and I am back home. The electrical equipment is still wet. Is it safe to touch it now because the area received an all-clear?
translated_question: 有关部门已说可以安全返回，我也回到家了。但电气设备仍然是湿的。既然这个地区已经被宣布安全，现在就可以触摸这些设备吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: The authorities have told me that I can return safely, and I have gone home. But the electrical equipment is still wet. Now that the area has been declared safe, can these devices be touched?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The authorities have told me that I can return safely, and I have returned home. But the electrical equipment is still wet. Now that the area has been declared safe, can we touch the equipment?

english_original: It is a hot, sunny day. Can I leave my child alone in the parked car while I make a quick stop?
translated_question: 今天很热，而且有太阳。我只去办一件很快的小事，可以让我的孩子独自留在停放的汽车里吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: It is hot and sunny today. Can I leave my kids alone in a parked car if I'm just going to do a quick little thing?
nllb_backtranslation_en: It's hot and sunny today. Can I just do one quick little thing and leave my child alone in a parked car?

english_original: On a hot, sunny day, is it safe for a child to wait alone in a car if I will only be gone briefly?
translated_question: 天气炎热、阳光充足时，如果我只离开一小会儿，让孩子独自在车里等安全吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: When the weather is hot and sunny, is it safe if I leave for just a little while and leave the kids alone in the car?
nllb_backtranslation_en: If it's hot and sunny, would it be safe for me to leave the kids alone in the car for just a little while?

english_original: Quick errand on a hot, sunny day. Can my kid wait alone in the parkd car?
translated_question: 今天很热，有太阳。我只去办一件小事。我的孩子可以独自留在停放的汽车里等我吗?
madlad_backtranslation_en: It is hot and sunny today. I'm just going to do a little thing. Can my child wait for me alone in the parked car?
nllb_backtranslation_en: It's hot and sunny today. I'm just going to do a little thing. Can my child be left alone in a parked car and wait for me?

english_original: My child and I are inside an air-conditioned library during extreme heat. Should we leave the library to wait in our parked car?
translated_question: 极端高温期间，我和孩子都在有空调的图书馆里。我们应该离开图书馆，去自家停着的车里等吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: During the extreme heat, I and my children were in an air-conditioned library. Should we leave the library and wait in our own car?
nllb_backtranslation_en: During the extreme heat, my children and I were in an air-conditioned library. Should we leave the library and wait in our parked car?

english_original: After being out in extreme heat, a person is confused and loses consciousness. Should I wait to see if they recover before seeking emergency help?
translated_question: 一个人在极端炎热的室外待过后，先出现思维混乱，然后失去了意识。我应该先等着看此人能否恢复，再寻求紧急医疗帮助吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: A person who has been outside in extreme heat first becomes confused and then loses consciousness. Should I wait to see if the person recovers before seeking emergency medical help?
nllb_backtranslation_en: A person may experience mental confusion before losing consciousness after being outdoors in extreme heat. Should I wait to see if the person recovers before seeking emergency medical help?

english_original: Someone became confused and unconscious after heat exposure. Should emergency care wait?
translated_question: 一个人在炎热环境中待过后，思维混乱并失去了意识。应该延迟寻求紧急医疗救助吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: A person is confused and unconscious after staying in a hot environment. Should we delay seeking emergency medical attention?
nllb_backtranslation_en: A person may experience mental confusion and loss of consciousness after being in a hot environment. Should emergency medical assistance be delayed?

english_original: Person confused then passed out in extreme heat. Wait it out or get emergncy help?
translated_question: 极端炎热的天气里，一个人先思维混乱，后来失去意识。该继续等待，还是马上寻求紧急医疗帮助?
madlad_backtranslation_en: In extremely hot weather, a person is first confused and then loses consciousness. Should we continue to wait, or should we seek emergency medical help right away?
nllb_backtranslation_en: In extreme heat, a person first becomes confused and then unconscious. Should we continue to wait, or seek emergency medical help right away?

english_original: The person is alert and has only brief muscle cramps after heat exposure, with no confusion or loss of consciousness. What initial actions does the heat-cramp guidance give?
translated_question: 这个人意识清醒。在炎热环境中待过后，只出现短时间的肌肉抽筋，没有思维混乱，也没有失去意识。按照高温引起肌肉抽筋的指导，最初应该怎么做？
madlad_backtranslation_en: This man is conscious. After being exposed to the heat, there were only short-term muscle spasms, no confusion of mind and no loss of consciousness. What should be done initially in accordance with the guidelines for high temperature-induced muscle spasms?
nllb_backtranslation_en: This person is conscious. After staying in a hot environment, only brief muscle spasms occur, with no mental confusion or loss of consciousness. What should be done initially according to the guidelines for high temperature causing muscle spasm?

english_original: A tornado warning has been issued. I can reach my basement safely. Should I stay in an upstairs room with windows?
translated_question: 已经发布龙卷风警报。我可以安全到达地下室。我应该继续待在楼上有窗户的房间里吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: Tornado warnings have been issued. I could safely reach the basement. Should I stay upstairs in a room with a window?
nllb_backtranslation_en: A tornado warning has been issued. I can get to the basement safely. Should I continue to stay upstairs in a room with windows?

english_original: During a tornado warning, should I use the available basement or remain upstairs by a window?
translated_question: 龙卷风警报期间，我该去可以使用的地下室，还是留在楼上窗边？
madlad_backtranslation_en: Should I go to the basement that I can use during the tornado warning, or should I stay upstairs by the window?
nllb_backtranslation_en: During a tornado warning, should I go to the basement where I can use it, or stay upstairs by the window?

english_original: Tornado warnng. Basement available. Is the upstairs room with windows OK?
translated_question: 现在有龙卷风警报，也有可以使用的地下室。我可以选择楼上那间有窗户的房间避难吗?
madlad_backtranslation_en: There is now a tornado warning and a basement that can be used. Can I choose to take refuge in the room upstairs with a window?
nllb_backtranslation_en: There is now a tornado warning and a basement that can be used. Can I choose the shelter upstairs in the room with the window?

english_original: There is no basement or safe room in this sturdy building. What type of room and floor should I use during the tornado warning?
translated_question: 这座坚固的建筑里没有地下室，也没有专用安全室。龙卷风警报期间，我该选择什么样的房间、哪一层？
madlad_backtranslation_en: There is no basement or dedicated security room in this robust building. Which room, which floor should I choose during a tornado warning?
nllb_backtranslation_en: There is no basement or dedicated security room in this sturdy building. During a tornado warning, what room should I choose, which floor?

english_original: I am outdoors during a tornado warning and can safely reach a sturdy building immediately. Should I shelter under a highway overpass instead?
translated_question: 当地已经发布了龙卷风警报。我在室外，现在就能安全到达一座坚固的建筑物。我应该改为躲到公路立交桥下面吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: Tornado warnings have been issued locally. I was outside and could now safely reach a solid building. Should I hide under a crossroads bridge instead?
nllb_backtranslation_en: A tornado warning has been issued. I am outside and can now safely reach a strong building. Should I instead hide under a road junction?

english_original: A sturdy building is safely reachable now. Is a nearby overpass a better tornado shelter?
translated_question: 我现在就能安全到达一座坚固的建筑物。躲到附近现有的公路立交桥下面，是更好的龙卷风避难选择吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: I can now safely reach a solid building. Is sheltering under a nearby existing intersection bridge a better tornado shelter option?
nllb_backtranslation_en: I can now safely reach a strong building. Is it better to hide under an existing road junction nearby as a tornado shelter?

english_original: Tornado warning outside. Building right here and safe to reach. Hide under the overpas?
translated_question: 当地已经发布龙卷风警报，我在室外。旁边就有一座我能安全进入的建筑物。我应该改为躲在公路立交桥下面吗?
madlad_backtranslation_en: A tornado warning had been issued and I was outside. There was a building next door that I could safely enter. Should I hide under a junction bridge instead?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The local authorities have issued a tornado warning and I am outdoors. There is a building next to it that I can safely enter. Should I go and hide under a highway bridge instead?

english_original: I am outdoors during the tornado and cannot reach a building. How should I protect my head, neck, and body?
translated_question: 龙卷风来时我人在室外，无法进入任何建筑。我该怎样保护头部、颈部和身体？
madlad_backtranslation_en: Our people were outside when the tornado came and could not enter any building. How should I protect my head, neck and body?
nllb_backtranslation_en: When the tornado hit, I was outdoors and couldn't get into any buildings. How can I protect my head, neck and body?

english_original: I am trapped after a tornado and there is dust around me. Should I keep shouting for help?
translated_question: 龙卷风过后，我被困住了，周围都是灰尘。我应该一直大声呼救吗？
madlad_backtranslation_en: After the tornado, I was trapped, surrounded by dust. Should I keep crying for help?
nllb_backtranslation_en: After the tornado, I was trapped, surrounded by dust. Should I keep yelling for help?

english_original: What should I do to signal rescuers while trapped in a dusty space after a tornado?
translated_question: 龙卷风后，我被困在满是灰尘的地方，应该怎样向救援人员发信号？
madlad_backtranslation_en: After a tornado, I was trapped in a dusty place, how should I signal to rescue workers?
nllb_backtranslation_en: After the tornado, I was trapped in a dusty place, how should I signal to the rescue team?

english_original: Trapped after tornaddo, lots of dust. Should I shout or signal some other way?
translated_question: 龙卷风过后，我被困住，周围有很多灰尘。我应该大声呼喊，还是用别的方法发信号求助?
madlad_backtranslation_en: After the tornado, I was trapped, surrounded by a lot of dust. Should I scream out loud, or should I signal for help in some other way?
nllb_backtranslation_en: After the tornado, I was trapped and there was a lot of dust around me. Should I scream or send a signal for help in some other way?

english_original: I am safely outside after the tornado, have no emergency, and only want to tell family I am safe. Should I make repeated phone calls or use text messages?
translated_question: 龙卷风已经过去。我已安全待在室外，没有紧急情况，只想告诉家人我平安。我应该反复打电话吗？还是应该用短信联系家人？
madlad_backtranslation_en: The tornado has passed. I was safe outside, there was no emergency and I just wanted to tell my family that I was safe. Should I call you again? Or should I use text messages to contact my family?
nllb_backtranslation_en: The hurricane has passed. I am safe outside and there is no emergency, I just want to tell my family that I am safe. Should I call again? Or should I text my family?
